q:
No sorry, Creamy Cropmen. 

What was his strat last week? Seemed like he added a bunch of players and dropped a bunch and got lucky a little as well? Was he clearly going for games played? He reached 1800+ last week and is projected for 1411 now. That is a huge drop. Tying to get to the bottpm of why he was so good last week
short: Ben F. (Creamy Cropmen) scored 1871 in week 3 by combining max volume (52 starter-games vs 45 to 48 for the next best teams) with roughly 300 points of hot production over projection. The 1411 projection assumes average output, so it is a regression, not a collapse.
answer:
Short version: it was both. He maxed out games played AND ran hot.

Games played: Creamy Cropmen scored 1871 for Nov 2 to 8, the best score in the league that week, from 52 starter-games in the 11 daily slots (not counting IR or bench). Angel Reese had 48 starts for 1762, Nifty Neighbas 45 for 1617, and you 45 for 1397. He filled the lineup on the heavy days (417 on Nov 2, 399 on Nov 4, 397 on Nov 6 with 12 starters) and kept Haliburton and Kawhi in IR so they did not eat active spots.

The add/drop churn: he made 13 transactions from Oct 26 on, and 6 adds in week 3 alone (tied with Trash Pandas for the league high). The pattern was streaming: cheap free agents whose teams had games on days he had open slots. Examples are Derik Queen (waiver), Saddiq Bey, Jaylen Wells, P.J. Washington, Devin Vassell and Nolan Traore. That looks clearly like a games-played strategy, and the volume edge over the field was about 5 to 7 extra starts, or roughly 150 to 200 points.

Luck: his starters averaged 36.0 FP per game that week against about 29.8 projected for the same players now. At projected rates his 52 starts would be about 1550, so roughly 320 points was hot production. Doncic had 87 and 64 in games, Franz Wagner 61 and 63, and streamers like Bey (40), Vassell (40) and Traore (46) hit on single nights. That part is unlikely to repeat.

Why 1411 now: the projection uses average per-game production, not last week's heat. His roster also has Haliburton and Kawhi on IR, Vassell is OUT, and Doncic has only 3 games this week. If he keeps streaming I would expect him to beat 1411, but realistically 1500 to 1600 rather than 1800. I did not search the web since this is a data question, and the luck estimate is approximate because it uses current projections, not the pre-week ones.

Takeaway: about 200 points of his edge was repeatable volume, about 300 was variance. To compete, fill all 11 slots on every game day.

moves.do: Fill all 11 starting slots every game day this week, streaming free agents on light days
moves.why: He started 52 players last week versus your 45, about 7 extra games at roughly 30 FP each, or around 200 points.
